Do not re-deliver in this case—that would undo your rollback; to stop KeyRelay from managing it, unbind the agent on the Agent Delivery page.

hint.fingerprint: Only the site's public status endpoint is called for fingerprinting; credentials are never persisted, only stored in the system keychain.
hint.captchaBody: This site requires a captcha. KeyRelay does not bypass captchas—click the button below to open the site's official page and complete the login and captcha yourself; then come back and click "Done, attach session". The page in the window is the site's own; we won't click or read it for you.
hint.captchaUnsupportedBody: This site requires a captcha, but its session uses a bearer access token rather than a cookie—KeyRelay's WebView fallback cannot capture such a session. Please connect via API key directly, or retry the login form above.
hint.captchaBearerBody: This site requires a captcha. Complete the login (including the captcha) in the official page that opens; KeyRelay reads the login credential the site itself saved in order to attach the session—it reads only that credential store, not page text or form inputs, does not click for you, and does not bypass captchas. When you are done, come back and click "I've signed in". The credential is never shown in the UI and never written to logs.

createDialog.title: New key
createDialog.body: On success the key is written directly to the system keychain; the UI shows only the last 4 digits. Confirm this key's purpose yourself.
createDialog.nameHintMid: , using your local today. It's just a label: rename it to anything you recognize.
createDialog.groupNoCap: This site type has no group concept; the key is created without a group field (per capability set, not hardcoded by type name).
createDialog.groupError: Couldn't read group list ({error}); the key will be created without a group field.
createDialog.groupUnboundWarn: No group selected: this site binds keys by group id, so an ungrouped key may be created but then rejected with 403. Whether ungrouped keys are allowed is a deployment setting we cannot detect here.
createDialog.groupRateWarn: Some groups have no usable rate from the site; they show "Rate unknown"—never fall back to 1×, so you don't pick a group on a wrong cost assumption.
createDialog.nameError: Couldn't generate a default name ({error}); please fill in manually.

rotationDialog.title: Rotate key
rotationDialog.introPre: Will run a fixed three-step rotation on "{name}" (local id {id}):
rotationDialog.step1: Create a new key on the site (plaintext goes straight to the system keychain)
rotationDialog.step2All: Re-deliver the new key to all delivery targets (none bound now, this step is a no-op)
rotationDialog.step2Some: Re-deliver the new key to {count} targets: {channels}
rotationDialog.step3Revoke: Revoke the old key on the site (remote id {id})—irreversible
rotationDialog.step3Skip: Old key has no site-side id; this step is skipped (not a failure)
rotationDialog.groupInherit: The new key will stay in the old key's group "{group}"; if that group no longer exists on the site, rotation is refused before anything is created (no unusable key is left behind).

groupCheck.matched: Group "{group}" still exists on the site; rotation will bind to it.
groupCheck.renamed: The group was renamed on the site: "{oldName}" → "{newName}". Rotation will bind to the renamed group.
groupCheck.missing: Group "{group}" no longer exists on the site. Rotation will be refused before anything is created; the old key will not be revoked.
groupCheck.missingNoId: Group "{group}" was not found on the site. This local record has no site-side group id, so matching is by name only—a site-side rename is indistinguishable. Rotation will be refused before anything is created; the old key will not be revoked.

rotationDialog.unmappedError: Channels for targets {targets} can't be identified; rotation would miss them. If you proceed and revoke the old key, they'd be stuck on it forever. Fix these targets first—this action is blocked.

rotationResult.revokeRevoked: Old key revoked on the site.
rotationResult.revokeSkipped: Old key has no site-side id; revoke skipped—check manually on the site whether it needs deletion.
rotationResult.revokeFailed: Old key revoke failed: {reason}. It's still valid; retry or delete it manually on the site.
rotationResult.revokeNotAttempted: Old key not revoked (stopped on a prior failed step). It's still valid and usable.
rotationResult.completedPre: Rotation completed: new key {masked} delivered to
rotationResult.aftermathPre: New key {masked} created and delivered to
rotationResult.fixHint: Fix the failure above first, then decide whether to retry; do not manually delete the old key before that.

settings.intro: All settings are stored locally in the database; nothing is uploaded.

autorefresh.title: Auto refresh
autorefresh.body: Off by default: KeyRelay does no scheduled networking for you. When on, it refreshes signed-in sites' balances and key lists on a timer; failures only log events and never break the loop.

balanceAlert.title: Balance alert
balanceAlert.label: Alert when balance drops below this (USD; 0 = off)

startupCheck.title: Startup check
startupCheck.label: Check delivery targets for external changes on startup (local files only, no network)

ui.title: Interface
ui.languageNote: UI text switches with the language; text returned by the backend (events, errors, site names) stays in its original language (the backend isn't internationalized yet).
ui.proxyAutoNone: No system proxy detected; will connect directly.
ui.proxyHint: Proxy takes effect on next app launch (gateway upstream on gateway restart). Proxy string validity is checked when a request is actually made: an invalid manual proxy errors directly; an invalid auto-detected proxy is skipped and falls back to direct (junk system values shouldn't keep the app from starting).

notify.enabledHint: While the master switch is off, the three options below have no effect: the service does not evaluate rules, persist a baseline, or send anything.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.body: Balance below threshold, expired sessions, key expiry, and config drift go through these channels. Notification bodies contain no keys and no raw site response text.
notify.system: System notification (macOS Notification Center / Windows Toast)
notify.webhookHintPre: If credentials are embedded in the URL (
notify.webhookHintPost: ), they're stripped before writing to the event table and export bundle.

rotation.title: Key rotation
rotation.body: Reminds you to rotate before expiry. Rotation is a three-step op: create new key → reinject all → revoke old; if any step fails it stops, never leaving "old key revoked but new key not injected".
rotation.error: Warn-before days can't exceed the rotation period.

autostart.title: Persistence & autostart
autostart.closeToTray: Hide to tray on close instead of quitting (when off, closing exits and background refresh stops too)
autostart.startHidden: Don't show the main window on launch (equivalent to --hidden on the command line)
autostart.autostartLabelPre: Launch on login (macOS writes a LaunchAgent, Windows writes a user-level startup entry). Takes effect on "Save"; autostart always passes
autostart.autostartLabelPost: —its purpose is background refresh, and a popup would break that. If the tray is unavailable the window still shows, otherwise you'd have no way to bring it back.
autostart.mismatchPost: . Click "Save" once to rewrite the system autostart entry per the toggle.
autostart.stateUnknown: Can't determine (autostart entry unreadable; possibly permission or path)
autostart.mismatchEnabled: An autostart entry is installed but the toggle is off (turn off and save to remove)
autostart.mismatchDisabled: No active autostart entry but the toggle is on (turn on and save to write it)

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.telemetryPre: Anonymous telemetry (off by default). This version only records the toggle; no data is sent—
privacy.autoUpdate: Auto update (off by default). When on, checks once on startup; install still needs manual confirmation.

save.ok: Saved. Refresh-interval changes take effect on next launch.
save.autostartFail: Settings saved, but login-autostart didn't sync: {error}
save.autostartMismatch: Settings saved, but the actual autostart state is "{state}", inconsistent with the setting.

validate.refresh: Refresh interval must be an integer between 0 and 86400 seconds (0 = off).
validate.threshold: Balance alert threshold must be a non-negative number up to 1000000 (0 = off).
validate.port: Gateway port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
validate.timeout: Webhook timeout must be an integer between 1 and 60 seconds.
validate.maxAge: Rotation period must be an integer between 0 and 36500 days (0 = off).
validate.warnBefore: Warn-before days must be an integer between 0 and 36500.
validate.warnGtMax: Warn-before days can't exceed the rotation period (the thing to warn about has to happen within that period).

export.title: Export & backup
export.bodyPre: Export includes sites, key metadata, consent records, and settings.
export.bodyStrong: The key body is not in the export
export.bodyPost: —it lives only in the system keychain. So encryption protects metadata (site URLs, key names), not the key.
export.diagBodyPost: : recent redacted events + a settings snapshot (no proxy or webhook values, only whether they're set) + version and library layout. It contains no key body, so there's no encrypted form.
export.resultUnregistered: . Note: this file wasn't registered in the "known exports" table; redaction audit won't scan it—verify it contains no plaintext credentials yourself.
export.diagResultUnregistered: . Note: this file wasn't registered in the "known exports" table; redaction audit won't scan it.

keychain.title: Keychain entry cleanup
keychain.bodyPre: Deletes all entries this product wrote to the
keychain.bodyPost: (by local database reference, one by one—no enumeration: macOS would prompt for authorization). Once the secret is gone it's gone: the site-side key still exists, but the local plaintext is lost forever.
keychain.localKeepPost: : sites, key metadata, consent records, and change history are all kept; only the keychain entries they point to are gone (re-fetching a key restores them).
keychain.dialogBodyPre: Will delete this product's entries in the system keychain one by one.
keychain.dialogBodyPost: : once gone, the local plaintext is unrecoverable; old values written to agent configs are unaffected (still in the files; re-deliver to overwrite).
keychain.dialogLocalKeep: Local database records won't be deleted.
keychain.agree: I confirm deleting the key entries in the keychain and understand they're unrecoverable
keychain.failHint: Failed entries remain in the keychain (a single failure doesn't abort the rest). Click again to retry; repeated failures usually mean keychain access was denied.
keychain.uninstallMid: uninstall hook, so the order is "run cleanup here first, then delete the app"—this product
keychain.uninstallPost: (and can't) auto-clean when you delete the app.

audit.title: Redaction audit
audit.body: Scans all this product's on-disk artifacts (database, WAL, backup dir, event table) for plaintext credentials. Only its own artifacts; not a full-disk scan.

alias.title: Model alias mapping
alias.body: Maps the model name the agent uses to the site real model name. For example, the agent always uses gpt-5.6, which actually routes to the site gpt-5.6-2026. Unregistered model names are treated as identity (not rewritten). Aliases do not apply when multi-site routing is off.

update.confirm: Update downloaded; relaunch the app to apply? Unsaved changes will be lost.

scrub.default: Update check failed; please retry later

gateway.title: Local gateway
gateway.bodyPre: Point any OpenAI-compatible agent's base_url at
gateway.bodyPost: —no key needs to go into their config. Listens only on loopback and requires the local token below.
gateway.allowLabel: Allow starting the local gateway (off by default; this toggle only allows it—starting still needs the button below)
gateway.multiSiteHint: When on, the gateway routes by **model name** across sites: aliases apply, candidates are ordered by balance health → rate → latency, and exhausted or repeatedly failing upstreams are removed and probed back after a cooldown. When off, the gateway uses only the single site chosen at start (same as before). **Off by default**—make sure every site has a usable key before enabling it.
gateway.portDirtyHint: Port changes need saving first and take effect on next gateway start.
gateway.hint: Put the URL and token into the agent's config; or on the Agent Delivery page check "point at local gateway" to have KeyRelay write it for you.
gateway.persistentHint: The token lives in the system keychain and persists across restarts—so to switch sites you only restart the gateway, no agent-side change (its config has the gateway URL and this token).
gateway.temporaryHintPost: : the keychain is unavailable, so the token changes on restart and gateway-pointing channels need re-delivery. Old tokens already in agent configs fail immediately.
gateway.copied: Copied to clipboard; may be captured by clipboard history (system or other apps). KeyRelay won't auto-clear the clipboard—that would fight your own copy operations.
gateway.rotatedWarn: Token regenerated: the old one fails immediately; gateway-pointing channels need re-delivery, and agents need a restart to read the new config.
gateway.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the gateway token? The old one fails immediately; gateway-pointing channels need one re-delivery.

startHint.noKey: No local keys under this site; create one on the Keys page first.

batch.bodyPost: bindings. Each must be checked individually—no "select all", since each actually rewrites an agent's config file.
batch.empty: No delivered channels yet. Deliver one on the Agent Delivery page first.
batch.unmappedPost: )—this agent name is not in the known channel table (older version or hand-edited binding); checking it will also fail with a reason
batch.hint: A single failure doesn't abort the rest (e.g. target file locked by another process). Successfully re-pointed ones aren't rolled back—the goal is "as many as possible", not "all or nothing".
batch.unmappedFull: Can't identify channel (possibly written under another home)
batch.unmappedApplyDetail: Can't identify channel (possibly written under another home); handle it manually on the Agent Delivery page

gateway.copyFail: Copy failed ({error})—select the token text above manually.

aftermath.title: Three things to know after a rollback (it restores the file, not the binding):
aftermath.drift: Overview keeps listing this target as "needs attention", and every Overview open logs another "external change" alert—the file no longer matches KeyRelay's last delivered content. This is expected; do not re-deliver because of it (that would undo the rollback).
aftermath.rotation: Rotating this key rewrites the file; it also stays a candidate when batch re-pointing to the gateway. If this rollback restored the file to a **different** key from an earlier delivery: later rotating or revoking that earlier key will not rewrite this file—come back and deliver a still-valid key, or the agent stays on a revoked key.
aftermath.unbind: To stop KeyRelay from managing it, unbind {agent} on the Agent Delivery page.
